policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Model Release Notes updated for Nov 16, 2026
items.summary: O published updated model release notes (Nov 16, 2026), reflecting changes/capability updates across model releases and the Model Spec.

items.headline: O: CA lawsuit seeks court-ordered changes after alleged safeguard failures
items.summary: A California lawsuit alleges O misled and endangered the public by developing advanced models without necessary safeguards; could drive compliance costs and constrain rollout timelines.

items.headline: V: W-8 capsule reenters/recovers; 3 vehicles in-space
items.summary: V announced successful reentry and recovery of W-8 after 35 days in orbit, with three vehicles operating. Demonstrates repeatable reentry/cadence—capacity execution evidence.

items.headline: V: South Australia reports successful triple-spacecraft return milestone
items.summary: SASIC reports V’s W-8 return/touchdown at Koonibba and notes regulatory/range operations oversight. Confirms execution of an additional return in a tight timeframe.

items.headline: V: Announces $251M Series D to scale space-based pharma processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, bringing total capital raised to $598M. Strong financing runway for missions and throughput.

items.headline: O: DevDay 2026 recap highlights GPT-6 Astra availability in API/ChatGPT Work/Codex
items.summary: O’s DevDay 2026 recap states GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast is available today via API and in ChatGPT Work/Codex, supporting production deployment and developer demand.

items.headline: V: W-7 mission page indicates new cancer-drug crystallization-in-orbit test
items.summary: V’s W-7 mission page describes an in-orbit mission to study cancer drug crystallization, supporting pipeline progress toward commercially valuable in-space manufacturing.
